blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Competitive examination success relies on conceptual clarity, factual precision, and strict time management.
Thorough alignment with the official syllabus and analysis of Previous Years' Questions (PYQs) guide effective preparation.
Consistent revision and regular mock test evaluation are essential to minimize errors and build accuracy.

blocks.content: Understanding the syllabus and analyzing previous years' questions form the cornerstone of competitive exam preparation.

items: Pay strict attention to the stage-specific marking schemes and negative marking penalties.
Prioritize high-weightage topics identified through systematic analysis of past exam trends.
